notes.title: Major Update: New Features, QoL Improvements, and (of course) BUGS!
notes.content: [p][/p][p]I am so excited to hit "publish" on this update! It is packed with some QoL improvements, new content, and new features![/p][list][*][p]The Community DLC,[/p][/*][*][p]Focus Feature - choose a bug to "focus" on and increase your odds of catching said bug,[/p][/*][*][p]Fixing store selection issues + a buy back feature,[/p][/*][*][p]FLIES are now a category![/p][/*][*][p]A pink frame will now signify when you have a bug that is part of an active Quest,[/p][/*][*][p]Easy scrolling for quests and inventories when using a controller,[/p][/*][*][p]Plus, other minor fixes and polish[/p][/*][/list][p]The Community DLC is real star here, so let's talk about that first. The DLC is made up of 30 bugs--all painted by our player community! And they contributed taglines and codex descriptions, too. Y'all are truly amazing. And as for the price, we felt it would be unfair to charge anything for mostly fan-made content, so this one is FREE. We really hope it brings you as much joy as it brought to us in putting it together! <3[/p][p][/p][p]The Focus Feature is a big part of this update as well! Now instead of hunting forever in hopes you find that [i]one[/i] bug (here's looking at you, California Dogface Butterfly), you can you Focus to hone in on it. The Focus Feature becomes available once you obtain Master level in that category. So as you level up your bug-hunting skills, more and more bugs will become available to focus on. Once activated, you'll see the orange Focus icon on your screen. [/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43461163/121b056eaaac7caf42f1568d9f60f687b36ffcbf.png"][/img][/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43461163/46cf836f81df3fd3fbdd77519a4106cfc9fe2937.png"][/img][/p][p]The last major thing I'll delve into for this update: Flies are now their own category! There are only a few flies in the base game, but the Community DLC adds several more, so with that you shouldn't have too much trouble leveling up that category. (Sorry, I couldn't count flies caught retroactively, so this count starts at zero once you download the update.) You can even donate flies to the University to grab a new statue. [/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43461163/c3cd5edbf0ea1f353b3695ee660adb9edd408ec0.png"][/img][/p][p]There's a lot more, but most of it was small QoL improvements, particularly for those using a controller. [/p][p][/p][p]Your support means so much to our family. We appreciate you all immensely! Craig and I are always interested to hear from you, so feel free to pop in to the Discord server and share your feedback, bad bug reports, or a fun photo of your pet beetle. :) Happy bug hunting!  [/p][p][/p][p] - Chera[/p]

notes.title: QoL Update, New Good Bug, New Tank, and Special Announcement!
notes.content:
Hey, friends! There are a few updates in this patch that will hopefully make your experience in Buggburg even better. :) Also, if you hadn't heard yet... Bug & Seek is now available on mobile devices for both iOS & Google Play! 
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43461163/ec705bae015b3a9ffc24464b29410499efc8ffc7.png[/img]

Here's are the updates included in this build:

[b]Option to Turn On Interaction Emotes[/b]
There's a new option in the Options menu to turn on Interaction Emotes. When turned on, you'll see an emote appear on your character when approaching an object that can be checked for a bug. This feature is automatic on mobile but optional for PC/Mac (coming soon to Switch).
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43461163/4d63e2d907ad8306d72f41f9ced2e9020b94a8aa.png[/img]

[b]Sell Back Decor at Full Price[/b]
Decor can be sold back to merchants at full price. There is an occasional bad bug where players are getting a storage tank when they attempt to buy something else. It'll take me a longer time to fix this, so in the meantime, you can just sell those tanks back at full price. :)

[b]Rope Ladder Can Be Fixed[/b]
The rope ladder is now permanently fixed after using it once for convenient travel from the main meadows area to the cave.

[b]Easier Controller Use When Shipping Jobs[/b]
When shipping jobs, your inventory appears in one screen. Those using controllers will no longer have to scroll to select all the bugs they want to ship.

[b]New Good Bug![/b]
Moss Mimic Stick Insect was added

[b]New Tank Added[/b]
A new 3-Bug Wooden Tank will appear sometimes at Bob's Bigger Store on Sunday

[b]Legendary = Extremely Rare[/b]
"Extremely Rare" was changed to "Legendary." This was a purely aesthetic choice to fit with our tabletop game that's currently in development. ;)

[b]Optimizations[/b]
Optimizations were made in the code for slightly faster load times (won't be noticeable on high-performing machines) and to guard against certain bad bugs occurring when placing decor.

AAAND... in other news, Craig (our game writer) just published a book! So if you like all those clever taglines and bits of dialogue, you might like the other words he's been writing, too. :) It's [url=https://www.amazon.com/Monster-Seven-Falls-Young-Mystery-ebook/dp/B0DVBG5T63/]on Amazon in paperback and eBook[/url].

As always, we so appreciate your support. Thank you for playing!! 

-Chera

notes.title: QoL update + bad bug fix + new tank
notes.content:
Hey, friends! We've been working hard on the mobile version of Bug & Seek, and in the process were able to optimize/fix a few more things for Steam. 

[list]
[*] [b]Bad Bug Fix [/b]- In the stores, some people were experiencing the wrong item being bought or sold. This bad bug is inconsistent and so a bit tricky to nail down, but I suspect it was caused by some lag between selecting an item and the item display in the store window. I changed a few things with the store function to optimize and hopefully prevent this from happening in the future! The item selected will have its details displayed in that shop UI window, so that's the item that will be sold or bought when you hit the button. Please let me know if you experience any other issues here!
[*] [b]Controller QoL Improvement[/b] - when shipping bugs for a job, all your inventory is now in one screen, so you don't have to fool with the scroll bar here. 
[*] [b]Balancing[/b] - Monarch Butterflies are now "uncommon" as opposed to rare. There were only 2 uncommon butterflies, and there should have been 3. We missed that on release.
[*] [b]New Tank[/b] - There is now a 3-Bug Classic Tank (the dark wood style) available in Bob's Bigger Store. It's in his Sunday rotation.
[/list]

Thanks so much for all your support. Craig and I will continue to make improvements to the game as we can. Thank you SOOO much for playing! 
-Chera

notes.title: Get Kickstarter Rewards mid-game + Job Calculation changes
notes.content:
There's a lot of polish in this patch! Several *bad* bugs were squashed, and I made a few improvements to existing features. Here's what you can expect:

[list]
[*] Jobs are now calculated based on the bugs you ship (+ bonus coins), so the more expensive the bugs, the better your reward. It always pays better now to ship bugs in a job rather than sell them in the shops.
[*] Kickstarter rewards! We had originally set up the in-game rewards to be delivered at the start of the game, not realizing that many players would be loading demo saves and beta saves. Of course you don't want to scrap all your hard-earned progress! So now--if you've received and activated keys for your Kickstarter rewards--you can hit the pause button and see a big red button on your menu that says "Kickstarter Rewards." Click that button, and those items will be dropped right into your inventory. If you've already gotten those items, well, you can get them a second time. :) Once claimed with the big red button, you won't receive the items again (unless you start a new game). 
[*] Lots of polish made to the controller function, making sure that cursor stays on the screen when viewing a UI menu. Let me know if I missed anything here, as this seems to be a menu-by-menu kind of fix.
[*] A confirm-this-choice dialogue box was added to the donations menu in the University, so you don't accidentally donate a bug you didn't want to. (I also added a fix for anyone who donated a bug while some of this code was broken, and now you have 2 common bugs in tanks. In the future we may add function for changing your donated bugs, but not just yet.)
[*] We had a few rogue bug-o's popping up in the Wetlands when they weren't supposed to. Rogue insects have now been sequestered to their appropriate locations. 
[/list]

Craig and I appreciate you all so much! If you have any feedback (good or bad) for us, we're always happy to hear it! Pop on in on our [url=https://discord.gg/NCrm8m5MAR]Discord server,[/url] and give us a shout. Have a wonderful week! 

-Chera

Enjoy the new content, and thank you so much for playing!

-Chera

notes.title: Controller Support + Steam Deck Playable!
notes.content:
We have just finished adding [b]controller support[/b] for Bug & Seek--both the full game and the demo. And while we were working on that, Steam was reviewing the game for [b]Steam Deck compatibility[/b]. We're happy to say that you can now experience Bug & Seek with either of these options! 

Note that our Store page will continue to say "partial controller support," as we do not have an on-screen keyboard for those instances where you name your bug or your Insectarium. You can use a regular keyboard for these things or skip them altogether. (I'm working on it this option for a future update!)

For those jumping in with controllers who are past the initial tutorial in the game, when in doubt, press the East button--this will make your cursor appear if you don't see it immediately, or return it to the default position. 🙂 You can also exit most UI menus by pressing the North button. 

The full controls are displayed in the Pause Menu.

I hope this makes your play experience all the better--and way cozier--this holiday season.

Thanks for playing!

-Chera

notes.title: Bug & Seek is Out Now 🎉🐞
notes.content:
The tiny team of two at So Peculiar Games is thrilled to release Bug & Seek so that you can enjoy all that the town of Buggburg has to offer. 👏

Buy it now to enjoy the 15% launch week discount! 🎉

Bug & Seek is the result of many hours spent in the woods, and many,[i] many[/i] more hours spent developing the game for nearly two years.

Come relax with Bug & Seek. There are no wrong choices, no energy levels to worry about, and plenty of time to complete quests and jobs. Build the best bug collection Buggburg has ever seen, and see if you can solve the mystery of The Great Heist! 🔍

notes.title: Bug & Seek | Live Demo Let's Play with Dev
notes.content:
Catch bugs and clues in this cozy bug-catching simulator, styled like an 8-bit classic. You’ve bought the local bug museum, abandoned after a mysterious robbery. Fill orders, build your collection, and upgrade your skills and equipment while exploring Buggburg and uncovering its secrets. With over 175 true-to-life bugs to catch, each bug also has its own unique (and humorous) tagline. It just might change the way you look at bugs. :)

Chat with lead developer Chera as she plays through the demo in this upcoming, cozy bug-catching simulator!

[b]Steam description:[/b]
Being developed by a husband-wife dev team living in the woods, Bug & Seek is a relaxing, open-ended, bug catching simulator with a mystery twist. In Bug & Seek, you've just sunk your life savings into buying an abandoned Insectarium (bug museum)! Once the lifeblood of the town and its economy, someone stole all the bugs in the dead of night. Now it's up to you to catch and sell bugs to fulfill requests from collectors, neighboring towns, schools, and universities, all while building your personal collection. Become a master bug hunter as you level up your bug-catching skills, upgrade your equipment, and expand your Insectarium. Meet the locals and complete quests to earn special items and discover what really happened during the Great Bug Heist.

[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/2265310/Bug__Seek/]WIshlist here[/url]. See you at the livestream!

notes.title: A new name, but the same game - changing the name from Insectarium to Bug & Seek
notes.content:
Hey everyone!

We wanted to share a quick update with you: we've decided to change the name of our game from Insectarium to Bug & Seek. 🧐

We were alerted to the fact that the name "Insectarium" conveyed a vibe to people that wasn't our intent and wasn't in line with the actual vibe of the game itself. So we decided to pivot to a name that more accurately conveys what the game is about -- cozy and whimsical bug-catching! 🐝

Here's a video update about it:

[previewyoutube=KXEcVIOFGZ0;full][/previewyoutube]


As always, please wish-list and following our game if you haven't yet -- it helps Insectarium gain visibility and lets us know the level of interest out there. You can also sign up for our [url=https://mailchi.mp/9556f464e34e/insectarium]mailing list here[/url].
